result_verbatim.description: Exact value, comparator and units. Preserve age-specific normal ranges and whether GFR is indexed. Serum creatinine is not interchangeable with measured GFR/clearance.
result_verbatim.title: Result Verbatim

value.description: Numeric reported result; null for qualitative results. Retain inequalities in result_verbatim.
value.title: Value

units.description: Exact documented units; do not invent or convert units.
units.title: Units

reference_range.description: Documented normal range or upper limit of normal, including age context.
reference_range.title: Reference Range

collection_date.description: Specimen/measurement date, ISO date at supported precision.
collection_date.title: Collection Date

collection_date_precision.description: Precision for collection_date; null if absent.

context.description: Baseline eligibility, on-treatment toxicity or MTX clearance; include hours after MTX and transfusion context only if stated.
context.title: Context

has_mention.description: Indicates whether the concept was mentioned in the text.
has_mention.title: Has Mention

spans.description: The verbatim text where this concept was mentioned.
spans.title: Spans

toxicity.description: Documented adverse event; do not infer toxicity from a lab without clinical interpretation.
toxicity.title: Toxicity

grade.description: Explicit CTCAE grade; never infer from a value alone.
grade.title: Grade

grading_system.description: Named grading system/version if stated; do not assume CTCAE v4 because the paper used it.
grading_system.title: Grading System

event_date.description: Documented toxicity date, ISO date at supported precision.
event_date.title: Event Date

event_date_precision.description: Precision for event_date; null if absent.

attribution.description: Clinician-attributed relationship to treatment, including treatment-related death only if explicitly stated.
attribution.title: Attribution
